versions.changelog: An unreadable host is not reported as down (hosts_unreadable); NTP/inventory no longer call it unreachable; a login refused with NoPermission gets the no-role error
Fixes from real-hardware testing: ESXi backup history, newest-first active tasks, honest capacity note, cluster moid, error hints
Roles for network callers (HLD §18): declares role metadata so vmware-policy 1.24.0 can limit each token to a role's tools and targets.

An account that logs in but has no vSphere role is named with a fix instead of failing obscurely (AIops#47); needs vmware-policy 1.23.0 (/healthz, audit correlation id). attention never reports OK when a target could not be read.
Session pools: calls on one target run side by side over HTTPS (HLD §16 D-13(2)); needs vmware-policy 1.22.0. get_access_info self-diagnosis.
mcp --transport https: serve MCP over HTTPS with bearer tokens (HLD §16)
mcp --expose read / --allow-write: offer only read tools plus chosen write tools
2.0: MCP tools renamed verb-first (see RELEASE_NOTES for the old -> new table); requires vmware-policy >= 1.18
MCP instructions now name the configured targets and how to choose one; a config that cannot be read says so instead of falling silent.
A stop signal always ends the server (bounded logout); active_tasks prints its unreadable-task note beside the table
Results name the target that answered (default_target, target field, instructions list targets); active_tasks counts unreadable tasks; Stopping the MCP server now logs out its vCenter session.

Stale alarms re-checked (license alarm cleared by evidence; unknown keeps severity), appliance alarms labelled, attention counts overlapping ESXi/vCenter hosts once, capacity views explained, perf vms balloon/swap, deployment-size without traceback.
CLI reads are audited under their MCP tool names; every CLI command declares what it reaches (needs vmware-policy 1.15.0)
health sensors say why a host has none; NTP source mismatch; over-committed datastores in the summary
Stale-alarm verdicts, newest-first event reads with windows and routine folding, real event names ranked, grouped host logs, sessions and license assignments.

host_log_scan reads host logs for the first time (0 findings before, 131 live after); unreadable logs are reported instead of looking clean; the daemon reports each line once and only critical host-log lines page the webhook; standalone hosts are no longer counted as clusters.
a dropped connection no longer keeps itself alive
the window this does not cover, said out loud
an open backup is not a failed one

_is_cluster used a leaf type name pyVmomi never reports, so every bundle lost its cluster context; event catalogue recovers 1887 extended ids; bundles no longer crash on standalone ESXi; vLCM stops counting unscannable hosts as non-compliant

First live run of the issue #26 backup-window tool found the coverage note blaming vpxd.task.maxAge, a name that raises vim.fault.InvalidName; the option is task.maxAge and the note now reads its real value.
fix: run the suite on a non-UTF-8 machine, and stop one skill answering for another
See RELEASE_NOTES.md for v1.9.0
Second-round fixes from the 2026-08-30 VCF 9.1 re-test; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.11.0 (the engine no longer fails open when rules.yaml cannot be read).

Read-only enforcement replaced a 33-string grep with an AST allowlist derived from pyVmomi's own metadata. Parameter descriptions now reach the MCP JSON schema (0% -> 100% coverage); additionalProperties closed; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.10.0.

Unreachable hosts no longer reported as misconfigured; event severity from vCenter's own catalogue; doctor authenticates every target; one config path across CLI/doctor/MCP; server.json starts the MCP server.
Standalone ESXi reported 0 VMs and 0% usage; vCenter-level alarms were invisible to the health summary; the documented SSL config key was one the code never read. Found on real hardware.
Fixes the server's self-reported version and the advertised tool count; adds a Claude Code plugin manifest.
vSphere 9.1 memory tiering + vLCM patch compliance + deployment size — 4 read tools (27→31). + review hardening (CLI 503-tolerance, compliance count). Beta caveats in RELEASE_NOTES.
Moved to vmware-skills GitHub org; MCP Registry namespace → io.github.vmware-skills. Links updated.
CLI writes now route through the shared guard()+audit_call() core via @guarded, exactly like the MCP tools (HLD I-1/I-8). Requires vmware-policy>=1.8.8.
Remove read-only switch and approval tiers; read/write authz delegated to RBAC. Plus accumulated fixes since 1.8.5.
A failure that is returned is now audited as a failure, and certificate/URL detail no longer reaches the agent. Both fixes v1.8.4 announced were incomplete.
Teaching error messages, domain exceptions no longer redacted on the way to the agent, and tool descriptions that state when to use each tool and what to call next.
Per-target username can now come from an env var, resolved per access like the password; documented credential variables corrected against what each repo's code actually reads
MCP server moved into the package namespace — fixes two skills in one environment silently overwriting each other's server; agent-guardrails.md for local/small models now ships in every skill
Read-only mode now documented on every surface that teaches it (SKILL.md, setup-guide, capabilities) and reported by doctor
Read-only mode (structural gate, 27/27 tools verified read at start-up), list-result envelope, declared environments; tool-count and tool-name doc corrections
Session-probe eviction fix (dead cached sessions were never evicted; None currentSession now treated as dead) + lockfile mcp 1.28.1 clearing three GHSA HIGH advisories.
Object investigation bundles (vm/host/datastore) + cross-vCenter attention: correlated drill-down with event timeline + offline HTML. MCP 23→27.
cluster_health_summary tool (22→23): one-glance cross-cluster triage with ranked top-N issues + offline timestamped HTML snapshots (summary --html); editable display template
Batch host-check boundary reads (NTP/services/certificate) via new _collect_objects helper — per-host serviceInfo/certificateInfo lazy reads collapse to one RetrievePropertiesEx (issue #31 tail).
Add host_log_scan MCP tool (issue #31 request); 21->22 tools
Batch all monitoring read paths via shared PropertyCollector helper
Large-inventory scale fix (issue #31): PropertyCollector batching replaces per-object lazy SOAP round-trips.
10 new read-only observability tools (MCP 11->21) + guided init wizard
v1.6.1 .env password b64 obfuscation
v1.6.0 trust architecture: undo tokens + governance harness (budget/audit/risk-tiers)
v1.5.39: AIops snapshot-delete async + honest timeout (token-burn fix), Storage browse timeout fix; others version-aligned
release alignment
